payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics used for evaluating the quality of generated text, including BLEU, perplexity, self-BLEU, and the percentage of unique n-grams.

claims.text: BLEU is used to measure the similarity between generated sentences and original data distributions.
Perplexity of a trained language model is evaluated as a proxy for fluency of the generations.
Self-BLEU measures the similarity of generated sentences to each other, indicating diversity.
The percentage of unique n-grams is evaluated to assess the diversity of the generations.
